recon.paper_id: 062_Głosek-Sobieraj_2018_The Effect of Growth Regulators and a Bi
warnings: Multiple biostimulant products tested - need to extract each vs control separately
Three-year experiment (2013-2015) - data reported by year
Five different potato cultivars tested - treatment effects vary by cultivar
Tables use letter codes for statistical significance - values with same letters do not differ significantly
Yield data in Table 4 uses dt ha⁻¹ units (decitonne per hectare = 100 kg/ha)
Some treatments may not show significant differences from control despite numerical differences
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: Statistical data within years; values followed by the same letters do not differ significantly at P≤0.05
recon.control_definition: Plots where growth regulators were not applied were the control
recon.treatment_definition: Four biostimulant treatments: (1) 0.1% Asahi SL biostimulator, (2) 1.0% Bio-Algeen S-90 seaweed extract, (3) 0.2% Kelpak SL brown algae extract, (4) Trifender WP fungal preparation
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Trifender WP contains fungal spores (Trichoderma asperellum) - this is microbial and may not qualify as biostimulant for the meta-analysis scope
recon.sample_size_source: A micro-plot experiment with a randomized sub-block design and three replications was conducted
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract yield data from Table 4 for each biostimulant treatment vs Control for each cultivar-year combination. Convert dt ha⁻¹ to kg ha⁻¹ by multiplying by 100. Three relevant biostimulant treatments qualify: Asahi SL (biostimulator), Bio-Algeen S-90 (seaweed extract), and Kelpak SL (seaweed extract). Exclude Trifender WP as it is microbial. Use LSD-based statistical significance indicators (letter codes) to assess treatment differences.

table_descriptions.Table 1: Weather conditions data - temperature and rainfall by 10-day periods
table_descriptions.Table 2: Infection rates by Phytophthora infestans (late blight) - percentage infection index
table_descriptions.Table 3: Infection rates by Alternaria alternata and A. solani (early blight) - percentage infection index
table_descriptions.Table 4: Potato yield in dt ha⁻¹ (decitonne per hectare) by treatment, cultivar, and year
table_descriptions.Table 5: Percentage share of different tuber size fractions in total yield
